title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
title_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Google Deepmind has unveiled a new AI model for robot control. In a pilot test on active Mercedes-Benz production lines, a humanoid robot reportedly achieved a 96 percent success rate.

Google Deepmind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that processes visual information, understands language instructions, and translates them into robot movements. The model builds on its predecessor, introduced earlier this year, which was designed to give robots full-body co
summary_en: Google DeepMind unveiled the Gemini 2.5 robotic model, integrating vision, language, and motion control to operate diverse hardware like Apptronik robots. In pilot tests at Mercedes-Benz plants, the model achieved a 96% success rate and increased task speed by up to 30%.

summary_zh: 谷歌发布Gemini 2.5机器人模型，在奔驰工厂测试中实现96%金属件分拣成功率，展现出更强的泛化操作能力

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布Gemini 2.5机器人模型，该模型通过整合视觉、语言与动作控制能力，实现了对Apptronik等多种硬件的统一操控。在匈牙利及德国的奔驰生产线实测中，机器人不仅能高效完成分拣任务，操作速度也较前代提升了20%至30%。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google DeepMind unveiled the Gemini 2.5 robotic model, integrating vision, language, and motion control to operate diverse hardware like Apptronik robots. In pilot tests at Mercedes-Benz plants, the model achieved a 96% success rate and increased task speed by up to 30%.

【起因与机理】旨在验证大模型跨硬件平台的通用操控能力，加速AI从数字世界向物理空间的落地

【涉及范围与推进】旨在实现跨平台通用控制，推进工业领域AI部署。

title: Dreeze, launched by Zerto founders to help companies recover from cyberattacks by restoring entire cloud applications, emerges from stealth with a $33M seed (CTech)
title_en: Dreeze, launched by Zerto founders to help companies recover from cyberattacks by restoring entire cloud applications, emerges from stealth with a $33M seed (CTech)
author: CTech
content_snippet:
Dreeze, a new Israeli cloud recovery company founded by the team behind Zerto, has emerged from stealth with $33 million in Seed funding, betting that businesses need a different approach to recovering from cyberattacks and other disruptions. The round was led by Norwest and Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Claltech.

title: Anthropic Founders to Cash Out $1.75 Billion in Blockbuster IPO
title_en: Anthropic Founders to Cash Out $1.75 Billion in Blockbuster IPO
author: Dylan Sloan
content_snippet: Anthropic PBC's seven co-founders will sell $1.75 billion of stock between them in next week's initial public offering, according to an updated prospectus released Tuesday.
summary_en: Anthropic revealed in an updated S-1 filing that its seven co-founders plan to sell $1.75 billion worth of stock during next week's IPO. This move allows the founders to cash out, with each taking home approximately $250 million at the offering's midpoint.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic在更新后的S-1招股文件中披露，七位创始团队成员决定在下周IPO期间集体抛售总价值17.5亿美元的个人股份。此举旨在趁着AI狂热窗口期完成变现，每位创始人将通过此次发行平均带走约2.5亿美元现金。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Anthropic revealed in an updated S-1 filing that its seven co-founders plan to sell $1.75 billion worth of stock during next week's IPO. This move allows the founders to cash out, with each taking home approximately $250 million at the offering's midpoint.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic七位创始人在公司IPO上市前夕：计划集体抛售价值17.5亿美元的个人股份
【起因与机理】利用估值高点进行大规模个人资本变现
【关键数据与实测】总价值达17.5亿美元，平均每人变现约2.5亿。
【各方立场与态度】利用IPO热潮进行大规模套现动作。
